about: The rules every knowledge-base record must follow (data/kb/*.json and each month's data/inbox/YYYY-MM/*.json). Checked by tools/check-data.js before anything is published.

fields.id: Permanent, readable, unique across the whole knowledge base, lower-case with hyphens, prefixed by type, e.g. fund-wellcome-heat-2026. Never reused.
fields.type: One of the types below. Decides how the record is drawn on every page.
fields.title: Short, plain, neutral name.
fields.summary: One to three sentences in plain language. Careful, diplomatic, non-political. No blame, no ranking, no individual people named.
fields.evidence: known (measured, official or peer-reviewed), inferred (reasoned from evidence, modelled or projected) or uncertain (reported, contested or not yet verified).
fields.sources: One or more source ids (type: source). Every figure must have one.
fields.as_of: When the fact applies: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.
fields.checked: When it was last verified: YYYY-MM-DD.
fields.status: current, superseded or retired. Superseded and retired records are kept, never deleted.
fields.places: Optional list of place ids (city-dhaka, country-bangladesh, region-south-asia).
fields.cycles: Optional list of cycle ids from the map (poverty, sleep, reactive ...).
fields.levers: Optional list of lever ids from the map.
fields.added: The month it entered the knowledge base: YYYY-MM. Set by the merge.
fields.changed: The month of its last change: YYYY-MM. Set by the merge.
fields.replaces: Optional id of the record this one supersedes.
fields.correction: Optional. When this record corrects something the site got wrong: what was wrong, in plain words. It is listed on /corrections/ with the record's summary as what changed.
fields.sorry: Optional. A short, sincere apology, shown with the correction where one is owed.

source.about: A publication, dataset or page that facts rest on.
rules: archive must be an archived copy (web.archive.org or archive.today) of url
sources of type source cite themselves: sources may be []
expect: two to five key terms the page must contain; tools/verify-inbox.js confirms each on the page or its archived copy

claim.about: One figure or finding, quoted by pages and films by its id.
rules: projections and models must be inferred or uncertain, never known

funding.about: A piece of money traced to protection from heat.
funding.amount: { value, currency, usd, fx_date } — usd may be null when unknown; { disclosed: false } when the amount was not made public
funding.optional: funder_kind (phil, public, dev or inv), philanthropy_role, segment (a kind of protection id), countries (ISO codes)

role.about: Who does what for a protection: an organisation or institution and its part in a lever.
rules: describes published work only; never a judgement of performance

milestone.about: A dated change: a plan adopted, a rule notified, a role created, a heatwave recorded.
milestone.optional: lat and lon (approximate) to place it on the Atlas

trigger.about: What releases money or action: a forecast, a measured index, a declaration.

question.about: An open, researchable question for the learning agenda.
